BiblicalUsage: Chashab in Aramaic is to regard, to reckon, and it appears once, in Nebuchadnezzar's confession: all the inhabitants of the earth are reputed as nothing, and He doeth according to His will in the army of heaven.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a humbled king saying men are reputed as nothing is the whole book of Daniel in one verse.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
